title: Verify my conversation thread: falling and rising drops, five variants, liquid objects, maps, video, phones
why: The thread is where people see me work. Every change to RaindropFeed, ThreadStage, ThreadVariants or thread.css must keep these true: the drop lifecycle follows the real feed, variant switches lose nothing, measured drag/resize/rotate, nothing overflowing at 320–430 px, and frame time no worse than the grid. It needs Playwright's Chromium and the dev server on 5173 (or LELU_BASE). It spends nothing. A YouTube refusal from the player is recorded as BLOCKED, never as passed.
